052/**
053 * YAMLLog
054 *
055 * @author creatorfromhell
056 * @since 0.1.2.0
057 */
058public class YAMLReceipt implements Datable<Receipt> {
059
060  /**
061   * The class that is represented by the O parameter.
062   *
063   * @return The class that represents the parameter.
064   */
065  @Override
066  public Class<? extends Receipt> clazz() {
067
068    return Receipt.class;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * USed to purge the objects of this datable.
073   *
074   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
075   */
076  @Override
077  public void purge(final StorageConnector<?> connector) {
078
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Used to store this object.
083   *
084   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
085   * @param receipt    The object to be stored.
086   * @param identifier An optional identifier for loading this object. Note: some Datables may
087   *                   require this identifier.
088   */
089  @Override
090  public void store(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final Receipt receipt, @Nullable final String identifier) {
091
092    final String fileSrc = "transactions/" + receipt.getId() + ".yml";
093    TNECore.yaml().add(fileSrc);
094    try {
095      final File file = new File(PluginCore.directory(), fileSrc);
096      final YamlDocument yaml = loadDocument(file, receipt);
097      if(yaml == null) {
098        return;
099      }
100      writeReceipt(yaml, receipt);
101      if(!saveDocument(file, yaml, receipt)) {
102        return;
103      }
104    } finally {
105      TNECore.yaml().remove(fileSrc);
106    }
107    receipt.clearDirty();
108  }
109
110  private YamlDocument loadDocument(final File file, final Receipt receipt) {
111
112    try {
113      final byte[] bytes = file.exists()? ReceiptBytes.read(file) : new byte[0];
114      return YamlDocument.create(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes));
115    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
116      PluginCore.log().error("Issue loading transaction file. Transaction: " + receipt.getId());
117      return null;
118    }
119  }
120
121  private void writeReceipt(final YamlDocument yaml, final Receipt receipt) {
122
123    yaml.set("id", receipt.getId().toString());
124    yaml.set("time", receipt.getTime());
125    yaml.set("type", receipt.getType());
126    yaml.set("source.type", receipt.getSource().type());
127    yaml.set("source.name", receipt.getSource().name());
128    yaml.set("archive", receipt.isArchive());
129    yaml.set("voided", receipt.isVoided());
130    writeParticipant(yaml, "from", receipt.getFrom(), receipt.getModifierFrom());
131    writeParticipant(yaml, "to", receipt.getTo(), receipt.getModifierTo());
132  }
133
134  private void writeParticipant(final YamlDocument yaml, final String prefix,
135                                final TransactionParticipant participant, final HoldingsModifier modifier) {
136
137    if(participant == null || modifier == null) {
138      return;
139    }
140    yaml.set(prefix + ".id", participant.getId().toString());
141    yaml.set(prefix + ".tax", participant.getTax().toPlainString());
142    for(final HoldingsEntry entry : participant.getStartingBalances()) {
143      writeBalance(yaml, prefix + ".starting", entry);
144    }
145    for(final HoldingsEntry entry : participant.getEndingBalances()) {
146      writeBalance(yaml, prefix + ".ending", entry);
147    }
148    yaml.set(prefix + ".modifier.region", modifier.getRegion());
149    yaml.set(prefix + ".modifier.currency", modifier.getCurrency().toString());
150    yaml.set(prefix + ".modifier.modifier", modifier.getModifier().toPlainString());
151    yaml.set(prefix + ".modifier.operation", modifier.getOperation().name());
152  }
153
154  private void writeBalance(final YamlDocument yaml, final String prefix, final HoldingsEntry entry) {
155
156    yaml.set(prefix + "." + entry.getRegion() + "." + entry.getCurrency() + "."
157             + entry.getHandler().asID(), entry.getAmount().toPlainString());
158  }
159
160  private boolean saveDocument(final File file, final YamlDocument yaml, final Receipt receipt) {
161
162    try {
163      final byte[] bytes = yaml.dump().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
164      //Serialize once; cache exactly the UTF-8 bytes successfully written to disk.
165      Files.write(file.toPath(), bytes);
166      ReceiptBytes.saved(file, bytes);
167      return true;
168    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
169      PluginCore.log().error("Issue saving transaction file. Transaction: " + receipt.getId());
170      return false;
171    }
172  }
173
174  /**
175   * Used to store all objects of this type.
176   *
177   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
178   * @param identifier The identifier used to load objects, if they relate to a specific identifier,
179   *                   otherwise this will be null.
180   */
181  @Override
182  public void storeAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
183
184    for(final Receipt receipt : TransactionManager.receipts().getReceipts().values()) {
185      if(receipt.isDirty()) {
186        store(connector, receipt, identifier);
187      }
188    }
189  }
190
191  @Override
192  public void delete(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
193    //nothing to see here
194  }
195
196  /**
197   * Used to load this object.
198   *
199   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
200   * @param identifier The identifier used to identify the object to load.
201   *
202   * @return The object to load.
203   */
204  @Override
205  public Optional<Receipt> load(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
206
207    final File file = new File(PluginCore.directory(), "transactions/" + identifier + ".yml");
208    if(!file.exists()) {
209
210      PluginCore.log().error("Null receipt file passed to YAMLReceipt.load. Receipt: " + identifier);
211      return Optional.empty();
212    }
213    return load(file, identifier);
214  }
215
216  public Optional<Receipt> load(final File file, final String identifier) {
217
218    if(file == null) {
219
220      PluginCore.log().error("Null account file passed to YAMLReceipt.load. Receipt: " + identifier);
221      return Optional.empty();
222    }
223
224    try {
225
226      try(final ByteArrayInputStream fis = new ByteArrayInputStream(ReceiptBytes.read(file))) {
227
228        final YamlDocument yaml = YamlDocument.create(fis);
229
230        if(yaml != null && yaml.contains("id")) {
231
232          final UUID id = UUID.fromString(yaml.getString("id"));
233          final long time = yaml.getLong("time");
234          final String type = yaml.getString("type");
235          final String sourceType = yaml.getString("source.type");
236          final String sourceName = yaml.getString("source.name");
237
238          final Receipt receipt = new Receipt(id, time, type);
239          receipt.setSource(ActionSource.create(sourceName, sourceType));
240
241          loadParticipant(yaml, receipt, "from");
242          loadParticipant(yaml, receipt, "to");
243
244          receipt.setArchive(yaml.getBoolean("archive"));
245          receipt.setVoided(yaml.getBoolean("voided"));
246          receipt.clearDirty();
247
248          return Optional.of(receipt);
249        } else {
250
251          PluginCore.log().warning("Invalid receipt file passed to YAMLReceipt.load. Skipping. Receipt: " + identifier);
252        }
253      }
254
255    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
256
257      PluginCore.log().error("Issue loading account file. Receipt: " + identifier);
258
259      return Optional.empty();
260    }
261    return Optional.empty();
262  }
263
264  public void loadParticipant(final YamlDocument yaml, final Receipt receipt, final String type) {
265
266    if(!yaml.contains(type + ".id")) {
267      return;
268    }
269
270    final TransactionParticipant participant = new TransactionParticipant(UUID.fromString(yaml.getString(type + ".id")), new ArrayList<>());
271
272    if(yaml.contains(type + ".tax")) {
273      participant.setTax(new BigDecimal(yaml.getString(type + ".tax")));
274    }
275
276    participant.getStartingBalances().addAll(loadHoldings(yaml, type, "starting"));
277    participant.getEndingBalances().addAll(loadHoldings(yaml, type, "ending"));
278
279    if(type.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).equals("from")) {
280      receipt.setFrom(participant);
281      receipt.setModifierFrom(loadModifier(yaml, type));
282    } else {
283      receipt.setTo(participant);
284      receipt.setModifierTo(loadModifier(yaml, type));
285    }
286  }
287
288  public HoldingsModifier loadModifier(final YamlDocument yaml, final String type) {
289
290    return new HoldingsModifier(yaml.getString(type + ".modifier.region"),
291                                UUID.fromString(yaml.getString(type + ".modifier.currency")),
292                                new BigDecimal(yaml.getString(type + ".modifier.modifier")),
293                                HoldingsOperation.valueOf(yaml.getString(type + ".modifier.operation")));
294
295  }
296
297  public List<HoldingsEntry> loadHoldings(final YamlDocument yaml, final String type, final String holdingsType) {
298
299    final List<HoldingsEntry> holdings = new ArrayList<>();
300
301
302    final Section startingSection = yaml.getSection(type + "." + holdingsType);
303    if(startingSection != null) {
304
305      for(final Object regionObj : startingSection.getKeys()) {
306
307
308        final String region = (String)regionObj;
309        final Section currencySection = startingSection.getSection(region);
310        if(currencySection != null) {
311
312          for(final Object currencyObj : currencySection.getKeys()) {
313
314            final String currency = (String)currencyObj;
315            final Section handlerSection = currencySection.getSection(currency);
316            if(handlerSection != null) {
317
318              for(final Object handlerObj : handlerSection.getKeys()) {
319
320                final String handler = (String)handlerObj;
321                final BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(handlerSection.getString(handler));
322                final HoldingsEntry entry = new HoldingsEntry(region, UUID.fromString(currency), amount, Identifier.fromID(handler));
323                holdings.add(entry);
324              }
325            }
326          }
327        }
328      }
329    }
330    return holdings;
331  }
332
333  /**
334   * Used to load all objects of this type.
335   *
336   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
337   * @param identifier The identifier used to load objects, if they relate to a specific identifier,
338   *                   otherwise this will be null.
339   *
340   * @return A collection containing the objects loaded.
341   */
342  @Override
343  public Collection<Receipt> loadAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
344
345    final Collection<Receipt> receipts = new ArrayList<>();
346
347    final File[] files = IOUtil.getYAMLs(new File(PluginCore.directory(), "transactions"));
348    for(final Receipt receipt : ReceiptFiles.load(files, file->load(file, file.getName().replace(".yml", "")))) {
349      receipts.add(receipt);
350      //Only parsing is parallel. Publish into the live manager on the caller thread, in file order.
351      TransactionManager.receipts().log(receipt);
352    }
353    return receipts;
354  }
355}
